introduction: Texas medical coverage applications are reviewed person by person. Children are assessed for Medicaid before CHIP when their application fits the CHIP route.
description: Texas medical coverage applications are reviewed person by person. Children are assessed for Medicaid before CHIP when their application fits the CHIP route.

sections.who: CHIP serves qualifying children younger than nineteen whose income exceeds children’s Medicaid limits but meets CHIP rules. Other Medicaid pathways have their own conditions.
sections.get: Health coverage under the approved program; review the plan and benefit notices for applicable services and costs.
sections.docs:
• Household and income information.
  • Identity and requested status evidence.
  • Pregnancy or other category information when relevant.
sections.apply:
1. Apply for health coverage

    Use Your Texas Benefits or request H1205/H1010.

  2. Supply verification

    Give HHS records for each person seeking coverage.

  3. Review the program decision

    Read whether Medicaid, CHIP or another route was assessed.
sections.after: Follow enrollment instructions and renewals on the case notice. Ask HHS about the appropriate pathway if adult eligibility differs from a child’s.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using CHIP program policy, Medical application form, Medical household rules. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Must I file federal taxes to apply?
HHS says a tax return is not required for medical-program application.
Is CHIP the first test for a child?
The handbook directs assessment for Medicaid first.
Can household members receive different decisions?
Medical household composition and eligibility can differ by individual.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
